text: Application: TTE650 993 K16 hybrid as described by German TTE24 retailer. Component: compressor_wheel. The reviewed factual register records Declared material family as High-strength aluminium; milled 6+6 wheels. Evidence status: supplier_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Retailer statement, not an alloy certificate. Existing manufacturer evidence describes a 50 mm compressor wheel inlet; this source housing-inlet dimension is a different datum. Exact alloy, temper and blade thickness not given. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-T010].

Application: TTE650 993 K16 hybrid as described by German TTE24 retailer. Component: compressor_housing. The reviewed factual register records Declared CNC-machined inlet diameter as 49.5 mm. Evidence status: supplier_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Retailer statement, not an alloy certificate. Existing manufacturer evidence describes a 50 mm compressor wheel inlet; this source housing-inlet dimension is a different datum. No definition of measuring plane, contour or tolerance; do not merge with wheel diameter. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-T011].

Application: RUF TRIBUTE new 3.6 litre air-cooled twin-turbo engine; distinct from M64/60. Component: crankcase_and_cylinder_heads. The reviewed factual register records Declared material family as Aluminium block and aluminium cylinder heads. Evidence status: supplier_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: New RUF-developed engine architecture, not original 993 Turbo or historic CTR2 technical evidence. Exact alloys, heat treatments and wall thicknesses are not disclosed. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-T021].

Application: RUF TRIBUTE new 3.6 litre air-cooled twin-turbo engine; distinct from M64/60. Component: valvetrain. The reviewed factual register records Declared architecture as Four camshafts; three-valve cylinder heads; variable cam timing and variable valve lift. Evidence status: supplier_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: New RUF-developed engine architecture, not original 993 Turbo or historic CTR2 technical evidence. Must not be used to label the two-valve/single-cam-per-bank Porsche M64/60. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-T022].

Application: RUF TRIBUTE new 3.6 litre air-cooled twin-turbo engine; distinct from M64/60. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Declared maximum power as {"PS":550,"engine_rpm":6750,"kW":405} PS / kW / rpm as printed. Evidence status: supplier_document_verified. Crankshaft power/rpm point, not turbo speed, map or proof stock M64/60 supports this configuration. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-T023].

Application: RUF TRIBUTE new 3.6 litre air-cooled twin-turbo engine; distinct from M64/60. Component: engine.
